resources.string: When a selected app is in the foreground at USB connection, suppress the USB chooser and its notification. Applies while the screen is on and unlocked; background apps do not trigger it. Changes take effect on the next connection.
USB behavior during Do Not Disturb

Warning: applying the default configuration skips confirmation and computer recognition. It may automatically enable file transfer, tethering, or USB debugging. Only connect trusted computers and check your default configuration.
Choose apps for Do Not Disturb
Search app names or package names, select apps, and tap Save. Selecting no apps disables suppression. Do Not Disturb takes priority over computer recognition and memory.
Search app names or package names
No matching apps. Clear the search or enable “Show system apps”.
Unable to load apps. Enable the module for system in LSPosed, reboot after updating it, then reopen this page.
